Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Download the application form from the official website: https://smportkolkata.shipping.gov.in/SMPA/en/.
Fill the application form carefully with correct information.
Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates.
Check all details carefully before submission.
Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the SMP Kolkata Land Revenue & Rent Recovery Officer recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the SMP Kolkata Land Revenue & Rent Recovery Officer post is 22nd October 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must be a Graduate from a recognized University/Institute with a minimum of 20 years of experience in land acquisition, revenue, record, searching, mutation, and conversion.

faq.question: Q3. What is the maximum age limit for the Land Revenue & Rent Recovery Officer position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for this post is 50 years as of 01-09-2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Land Revenue & Rent Recovery Officer post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 57,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Interested candidates need to apply offline by sending their application form to the address mentioned in the official notification.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the post of Land Revenue & Rent Recovery Officer.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The job type for this position is Contractual.

faq.question: Q9. What are the selection methods for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process includes a Written/Proficiency Test followed by a Personal Interview.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of Syama Prasad Mookerjee Port Kolkata.
